New. Upstream ships no tests, no CI and no CPU path, so nothing could be validated against this repository alone. Parameterised over all 14 variants plus the cross-variant image-equality oracle.

scoped_out.reason: The per-variant CMakeLists.txt static-library dev path is dead as shipped, on CUDA as well as ROCm: target_include_directories points PRIVATE at <variant>/third_party/glm, which contains only stbi_image_write.h, and the per-variant .gitmodules declaring that submodule registers no gitlink (git submodule status lists only the repository-root third_party/glm). Nothing consumes it -- every consumer, including EnvGS, builds the torch extension via setup.py. Porting it would mean first fixing an upstream build break. Registered as a deferral so it is reviewed with this port.
